name: cc-cold-cache-guard
description: Holds prompts sent to a session whose prompt cache has gone cold, and offers a cheap handoff (summarized by a local LLM or a small Claude model) instead of an expensive full cache write.

provider.title: Handoff provider
provider.description: Who summarizes the handoff: Claude through this session's API (anthropic) or a local OpenAI-compatible server such as LM Studio (local).

anthropic_model.title: Claude model
anthropic_model.description: Anthropic provider only. An alias (haiku, sonnet, opus) or a full model id.

anthropic_effort.title: Claude effort
anthropic_effort.description: Anthropic provider only. Ignored by models without an effort setting, including Haiku 4.5.

auto_continue_choice.title: Auto-continue choice
auto_continue_choice.description: Add a cold-cache option that generates the handoff, runs /clear and sends it right away.

idle_minutes.title: Idle threshold (minutes)
idle_minutes.description: Minutes of idleness before a prompt is held. auto = the cache TTL detected from the transcript minus the margin below.

auto_margin_minutes.title: Auto margin (minutes)
auto_margin_minutes.description: With idle_minutes auto: how many minutes before the cache TTL to start holding prompts.

fallback_ttl_minutes.title: Fallback cache TTL (minutes)
fallback_ttl_minutes.description: Cache TTL assumed when the transcript doesn't show one.

llm_base_url.title: Local server URL
llm_base_url.description: Local provider only. Base URL of the OpenAI-compatible server.

model.title: Local model
model.description: Local provider only. Empty = the first loaded model.

request_timeout_seconds.title: Request timeout (seconds)
request_timeout_seconds.description: Limit for the summarizing call; must stay below the hooks module's 10-minute limit.

max_output_tokens.title: Max handoff tokens
max_output_tokens.description: Output cap for the handoff. Anthropic caps it at 64000.

max_transcript_chars.title: Max transcript characters
max_transcript_chars.description: How much of the condensed transcript is sent to the summarizer (620000 is about 177k tokens). Sized for a 200k-token context; a value that won't fit the model makes the handoff unavailable and says what would.
